about: Windows lists the enabled cores; the SMU is addressed by (chiplet, physical slot), eight slots per chiplet. 'build' maps with the fuse map (one mask per chiplet, bit N set means slot N is fused off) and refuses when the fuses and Windows disagree about the core count. 'fallback' assumes the top slots are the fused-off ones. A pair is [chiplet, slot].
